text: Devron (YS) Ltd. (the "Applicant") is the owners of lands municipally known as 2779, 2781 Yonge Street & 15-17, 19-21 Strathgowan Avenue (the "Subject Site"). The Subject Site is located at the south-east corner of Yonge Street and Strathgowan Avenue. On February 21, 2013, the former owner of the property, 1655584 Ontario Limited, submitted a Zoning By-law Amendment application to the City to permit the development of a 9-storey residential building with ground floor commercial uses (the "Application"). On November 28, 2014, the owner appealed the Application to the Ontario Municipal Board ("OMB") (now the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal ("LPAT")) as OMB/LPAT File No. PL141372. On February 3, 2016, City Council adopted a settlement of the OMB appeal of the Application as Item CC.12.12.
